The Swedish Patent Gazette was a PDF publication containing announcements concerning patent applications and patents valid in Sweden, including European patents. It was published until February 2026, when it was replaced by electronic announcements in the Search PRV’s databases e-service.

The announcements published by PRV make it possible to monitor competitors’ patent activities in Sweden, follow patent applications within specific fields of technology, and access other relevant patent information.

The Swedish Patent Gazette was published every Tuesday, except on public holidays.

The gazette archive is available from our ftp-server with the following connection information:
URL: ftp://opendata.prv.se
Username: OpenDataSource
Password: opendata
Directory: Svensk_Patenttidning
sv:
Svensk patenttidning var en publikation i PDF-format som innehöll kungörelser om patentansökningar och patent med verkan i Sverige, inklusive europeiska patent. Tidningen publicerades fram till februari 2026, då den ersattes av elektroniska kungörelser i e-tjänsten Sök i PRV databaser.

Kungörelserna från PRV gör det möjligt att bevaka konkurrenters patentaktiviteter i Sverige, följa patentansökningar inom särskilda teknikområden och ta del av annan relevant patentinformation.

Svensk patenttidning publicerades varje helgfri tisdag.

Tidningsarkivet finns tillgänglig via vår ftp-server med följande inloggningsuppgifter:
URL: ftp://opendata.prv.se
Användare: OpenDataSource
Lösenord: opendata
Katalog: Svensk_Patenttidning

en: File Inspection is PRV's public archive for patent applications, Supplementary Protection Certificate (SPC) and extensions of SPC. Here you can view original documents and certain bibliographic data in all the public patent applications from 2004 onwards. The documents can be opened directly in the archive or downloaded as PDF files. A patent application is available to the public 18 months after the filing date or if priority is invoked 18 months after the application was originally filed.
sv: Aktinsyn är PRV:s offentliga arkiv för patentansökningar, tilläggsskyddsärenden samt förlängda tilläggsskyddsärenden. Här kan du titta på originalhandlingar och vissa bibliografiska uppgifter i alla offentliga patentansökningar från 2004 och framåt. En patentansökan blir offentlig efter 18 månader från ansökans ingivningsdag, eller om prioritet åberopas, 18 månader från prioritetsdagen. Dokumenten öppnas direkt i arkivet eller laddas ner som pdf-filer.

PRV publishes the contents of the Swedish Trademark Database via a collection of files that can be downloaded from our ftp server. The data files and associated image files (compressed in zip archives) are made available in XML format and are updated daily. They are available via a full withdrawal as well as via daily incremental updates.

The database is available from our ftp-server with the following connection information:
URL: ftp://opendata.prv.se
Username: OpenDataSource
Password: opendata

Further documentation about usage and formats is available on the ftp-server in the folder "TrademarkExport/NewExport/Documentation".
sv:
PRV publicerar innehållet i Svensk Varumärkesdatabas via en samling filer som kan laddas ned från vår ftp-server. Datafilerna och tillhörande bildfiler (komprimerade i zip-arkiv) tillgängliggörs i XML-format och uppdateras dagligen. De finns tillgängliga via ett fulluttag samt via dagliga inkrementella uppdateringar.

Databasen finns tillgänglig via vår ftp-server med följande inloggningsuppgifter:
URL: ftp://opendata.prv.se
Användare: OpenDataSource
Lösenord: opendata

Ytterligare dokumentation kring användning och format finns på ftp-servern i mappen "TrademarkExport/NewExport/Documentation".

Svensk Varumärkestidning (the Swedish Trademark Gazette) publishes all newly registered trademarks. It helps you monitor the trademarks that other actors on the market register. It also contains alterations and corrections of registrations during the registration period, renewals and removed registrations.

The gazette is published in PDF format on our website every Monday, in Swedish. This data set contains all issues that have been published since 1999-10-15.

The dataset is available from our ftp-server with the following connection information:
URL: ftp://opendata.prv.se
Username: OpenDataSource
Password: opendata

As of January 26, 2026, the Swedish Trademark Journal transitioned from being a daily and weekly edition in PDF format to an online solution with daily publication of announcements. Svensk Varumärkestidning (the Swedish Trademark Gazette) publishes all newly registered trademarks. It helps you monitor the trademarks that other actors on the market register. It also contains alterations and corrections of registrations during the registration period, renewals and removed registrations.

The gazette is published in PDF format on our website every Monday, in Swedish. This data set contains all issues that have been published since 1999-10-15.

The dataset is available from our ftp-server with the following connection information:
URL: ftp://opendata.prv.se
Username: OpenDataSource
Password: opendata
Path: SvenskVarumärkestidning
